lede: The biggest item this week is at Ouray County's Planning Commission on August 19, where three public hearings include a proposed repeal of an entire section of the county's land use regulations — the kind of wholesale code change that quietly reshapes what gets built and where for years to come. On the same day, Telluride's HARC takes up preliminary large-scale review of the Shandoka Lot Redevelopment on Black Bear Road, and the Parks & Rec Commission considers fee increases at Town Park Campground. SMART's board also meets August 13 to vote on resolutions restructuring the Gondola Advisory Committee and assigning professional services tied to the voter-approved 3A gondola tax.

notable.stake: Repeal of entire land-use code section could reshape county development rules.
